name: Tara K. Richardson
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Tara K. Richardson, an attorney with Richardson and Ringe PLLC in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Family Law situations.
She received legal training from Seattle University School of Law. She graduated from law school in 1998. Tara Richardson became licensed to practice law in 1998.
Tara Richardson was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that she is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012, 2017 - 2026.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
